definitions.gloss: whipped to firm peaks; whipped about 80 percent
definitions.explanation: A stage of whipping cream where it holds firm, standing peaks and keeps its shape. Literally "eight-tenths whipped." Used when the cream must stay put, as for piping or decorating.

examples.japanese: ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{八分立|はちぶだ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Whip the cream to firm peaks.

examples.japanese: {八分立|はちぶだ}てなら⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: At firm peaks, the cream keeps its shape well.

examples.japanese: ⟦デコレーション→デコレーション：23431_dekoreeshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦しっかりした→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧{八分立|はちぶだ}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: For decorating, use firmly whipped cream at the firm-peak stage.

notes:
A baking term literally meaning "eight-tenths whipped," formed from {八分|はちぶ} (eight parts) + {立|だ}て (whipping, from ⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧). Describes cream whipped until it holds firm, standing peaks — stiffer than ⟦{七分立|しちぶだ}て→七分立て：29704_shichibudate⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {八分立|はちぶだ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to whip to firm peaks
- {八分立|はちぶだ}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: firmly whipped cream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{七分立|しちぶだ}て→七分立て：29704_shichibudate⟧: whipped to soft peaks — one stage softer, still flows
- ⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧: to whip, to beat — the underlying verb
